<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The '''Saiyan Space Pod''' is a one-person spacecraft and the main way to travel between worlds: [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]], the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. Each destination has its own unlock rule.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting a Space Pod == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
* '''Prepare for Namek''' ([[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 15) rewards a Saiyan Space Pod.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] can grant a Saiyan Space Pod as a wish.
* '''Crafting table:''' recipe below. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar#Radar parts|Dragon Radar]] for the parts.
</translate>
{{Recipe|saiyan_ship}}

<translate>
== Boarding and flying == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
# Right-click a block with the item to place the pod.
# Right-click the pod to open its hatch, then right-click again to climb in.
# Steer with the mouse and the movement keys. Hold {{Key|Space}} to rise and the Second Function key ({{Key|Left Alt}} by default) to descend. The pod flies at 21.6 blocks per second and rises or descends at 7.

<!--T:11-->
Hit the pod to pick it back up as an item. Any player can pick up any pod.

<!--T:35-->
The pod uses the controls and rules shared by every [[Special:MyLanguage/Vehicles|vehicle]]: you can't fire techniques while you ride it, and [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]] switches off when you climb in. Since version 2.2 it has a new model, hums while someone flies it, leaves a thin trail of exhaust and leans into turns.
</translate>

<translate>
== Travelling == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
While you sit in the pod, press {{Key|H}} to open the '''Space Pod''' menu and pick a destination. You travel with the pod: it lands with you at the destination, ready to take you somewhere else. Locked destinations show up grayed out.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:30-->
The list also shows two locked entries, '''Cereal Planet''' and '''Beerus Planet''', reserved for add-on dimensions. Server owners and add-ons can add their own destinations (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod Destinations|Space Pod Destinations]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Other uses == <!--T:31-->

<!--T:32-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] quest '''Parts for Bulma''' asks for a Saiyan Space Pod, along with other parts.
